meta.ogDescription: Compare the cruise lines Dean books and find your next voyage with personal support at no cost to you.

hero.heading: One advisor. *Every ocean.*
hero.lede: From adults-only escapes to family adventures, luxury voyages and LGBTQ+ charters, let’s find your fit. Use my Virgin Voyages link to book independently, or contact me first about booking with my support on another line.

cta.heading: Not sure where to start? *Let’s talk.*
cta.lede: Tell me who’s sailing and what you’d love to experience. We’ll explore your options together, with my planning help at no cost to you.

rockstar.heading: Cruise like a RockStar
rockstar.intro: Three ways to sail: Mega RockStar, RockStar and Non-RockStar. Find the experience that fits your voyage.
rockstar.regular: Inside, Sea View or Sea Terrace — with all the voyage inclusions above.
coreItems: All shared voyage inclusions, plus suite accommodation
Richard’s Rooftop, RockStar Agent team and priority access
Curated in-suite bar — first round included
Classic Wi-Fi — one device per sailor

rockstar.note: RockStar shipwide alcoholic drinks are extra. Premium drinks, dining extras and some ticketed experiences cost extra. Benefits and connectivity depend on your fare, sailing and availability.
